profile.name: MPI SENTIO晶圆探针台
profile.description: 这是一类用于半导体晶圆测试的自动或半自动探针台系统，可对晶圆卡盘进行XY、Z和旋转定位，并支持接触/分离高度控制、真空吸附、晶圆地图步进与可选热卡盘功能。该设备常用于晶圆级电学测量、器件表征、失效分析以及带有自动装载、显微镜或硅光子对准模块的测试流程。
profile.description_en: This is an automatic or semi-automatic wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer testing. It provides XY, Z, and rotational chuck positioning, contact/separation height control, vacuum holding, wafer map stepping, and optional thermal chuck capability. It is commonly used for wafer-level electrical measurements, device characterization, failure analysis, and test workflows with optional auto-loading, microscope, or silicon photonics alignment modules.
